research_mode: official Home Office, ONS and National Data Library sources only; PFA/CSP geography, rate calculation, revisions, classification breaks and rural-urban context; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Pre-2019 negative quarterly values
verified_claims: some quarterly cells before 2019 can contain negative numbers
the values arise from the historical return mechanism
limitations: negative values are not impossible crime counts to be clipped to zero
the period and return method must be retained

sources.name: Cumulative-return deduction mechanism
verified_claims: before 2019 forces could deduct transferred or cancelled crimes from cumulative monthly returns
the deduction could create a negative value within a quarter
limitations: the mechanism must not be interpreted as negative incidents
historical aggregation requires the full financial-year context

sources.name: Financial-year accuracy rationale
verified_claims: the historical deduction system was designed to keep financial-year figures accurate
it also reduced resubmission burden on forces
limitations: quarterly volatility can remain even when annual totals reconcile
the rationale does not remove other data-quality limitations

sources.name: Offence 49A introduction
verified_claims: Making off without payment code 49A was introduced separately in April 2013
the classification boundary is explicitly documented
limitations: pre- and post-introduction coding must be versioned
the code change is not an incident trend by itself

sources.name: Offence 49A prior classification
verified_claims: before April 2013 making off without payment was included within code 53B
the later separate code changes category composition
limitations: 53B before 2013 is not directly identical to 53B afterward
historical extraction must use the reference table

sources.name: Offence 49A historical back series
verified_claims: a back series for offence 49A is provided for 2002/03 to 2012/13
the back series supports a more consistent time series
limitations: back-series values are reconstructed rather than uniformly contemporaneous
series provenance must remain visible

sources.name: Offence 49A back-series provenance
verified_claims: the 49A back series mixes actual force data and estimated data
the guide explicitly discloses this mixed provenance
limitations: actual and estimated components must not be treated as equally observed
confidence and provenance fields are required

sources.name: April 2017 burglary classification
verified_claims: a new burglary classification was introduced from April 2017
the change replaced earlier domestic and non-domestic categories
limitations: classification change can create discontinuity
old and new categories require mapping rather than simple renaming

sources.name: Residential and non-residential burglary split
verified_claims: residential and non-residential burglary became the principal subcategories from April 2017
they replaced domestic and non-domestic burglary respectively
limitations: the terms are not guaranteed to have identical boundaries
comparisons require the official classification notes

sources.name: Residential burglary boundary definition
verified_claims: residential burglary includes buildings or parts of buildings within or forming part of a dwelling boundary
the definition extends beyond the main occupied structure
limitations: the statistical definition is not a cadastral parcel rule
building-context data are required for local interpretation

sources.name: April 2023 residential-burglary split
verified_claims: from April 2023 residential burglary was split into home and unconnected-buildings subcategories
the change adds detail within residential burglary
limitations: pre-2023 series lacks the same split
new subcategories must not be backfilled without official data

sources.name: Financial Quarter 1 definition
verified_claims: Quarter 1 covers April to June
the quarter is interpreted with the Financial Year field
limitations: calendar-quarter labels must not be substituted
financial-year context is mandatory

sources.name: Financial Quarter 2 definition
verified_claims: Quarter 2 covers July to September
the quarter is interpreted with the Financial Year field
limitations: calendar-year-only grouping can mislabel the period
financial-year context is mandatory

sources.name: Financial Quarter 3 definition
verified_claims: Quarter 3 covers October to December
the quarter is interpreted with the Financial Year field
limitations: quarter 3 belongs to the starting financial year
calendar-year aggregation requires explicit conversion

sources.name: Financial Quarter 4 definition
verified_claims: Quarter 4 covers January to March
the quarter completes the financial year that began in the previous calendar year
limitations: calendar-year labels can assign Q4 to the wrong financial year
period keys must include both fields

sources.name: Financial-year and quarter period key
verified_claims: Financial Year combined with Financial Quarter identifies the recording period
both fields are required for an unambiguous quarterly key
limitations: quarter alone is not unique
recording period is distinct from outcome date or publication date

sources.name: Local PRC dataset July 2026 update
verified_claims: the National Data Library record was last updated on 8 July 2026
the publisher is the Home Office and the licence is Open Government Licence
limitations: catalogue update date is not an observation date
the linked resource edition must still be checked

sources.name: Rolling 12-month local PRC totals
verified_claims: the local police-recorded-crime dataset contains rolling 12-month totals
data points represent period-end totals rather than single-quarter counts
limitations: rolling windows overlap and are not additive
period-end metadata must remain explicit

sources.name: Historical annual period-end points
verified_claims: the dataset shows financial-year-end points from 2002/03 through 2006/07
these precede the later quarterly sequence
limitations: annual and quarterly frequencies must not be merged as equal intervals
classification changes still apply

sources.name: Quarterly period-end points from June 2007
verified_claims: quarter-end data points are provided from June 2007 onward
the values are rolling 12-month totals
limitations: successive points overlap by nine months
differences are not quarterly incident counts
